subject: Invoice routing playbook + renewal migration handoff
messages:
From: Logan Wright <logan.wright@redwoodinference.com>
To: Alex Kim <alex.kim@bluearc.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Thu, 24 Jun 2027 15:20:00 -0700
Subject: Invoice routing playbook + renewal migration handoff

Alex — thanks again for the time today. As discussed, BlueArc's renewal is up in September and we want to make the transition from your current direct invoice to AWS Marketplace billing without disrupting the service or your accounting controls.

High-level proposal: 
- Convert renewal to an AWS Marketplace subscription that mirrors current term and list price.
- Issue final direct invoice covering runout period (if any) and start marketplace billing on the renewal effective date.
- Provide a one-time credit (3% of term) to account for migration paperwork and to keep your FY27 budget neutral.

Immediate asks from your procurement team to get this moving: marketplace SKU mapping, exact PO format required, and any billing contact details for invoice matching. I attached a preliminary SKU mapping for reference.

Next steps I propose: 
1) You share PO format/mandatory fields by EOD Monday.
2) I loop in Finance for DocuSign amendment and final SKUs.
3) We target a 2-week window in July for DocuSign and marketplace entitlement setup so everything is ready before the September renewal.

Ben and Marissa are copied — Ben will own invoice routing, Marissa will own the enablement/co-sell paperwork.

Thanks,

— Logan Wright
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
logan.wright@redwoodinference.com
+1 (415) 555-0123

Attachment: Marketplace_SKU_Mapping.xlsx (spreadsheet with proposed SKU -> product mappings)

From: J. Sullivan <j.sullivan@procure.bluearc.com>
To: Logan Wright <logan.wright@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Alex Kim <alex.kim@bluearc.com>, Contracts <contracts@bluearc.com>
Date: Mon, 28 Jun 2027 09:04:00 -0400
Subject: Re: Invoice routing playbook + renewal migration handoff

Logan — appreciate the clear plan. A few clarifying points from procurement and contracts: 

1) PO format: we require line-item SKUs, unit price, quantity, our PO number, and the billing contact name/email. We also need a separate invoice that references our PO number exactly as shown.
2) Marketplace considerations: our finance team needs to know whether the marketplace invoice will include tax details and if AWS will issue the invoice to BlueArc or bill via reseller.
3) Amendment: we can sign an amendment via DocuSign but need to confirm the effective date aligns to our renewal window (Sept 1).

I'll attach our standard PO template and a signed placeholder PO to speed the test run. Also, please send a contact at Redwood Finance who can confirm invoice formatting.

Thanks — J.

Attachment: BlueArc_PO_Template_v3.docx; BlueArc_PO_45892.pdf (placeholder PO)

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
To: J. Sullivan <j.sullivan@procure.bluearc.com>, Logan Wright <logan.wright@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>, Mina Haddad <mina.haddad@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Mon, 28 Jun 2027 12:30:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Invoice routing playbook + renewal migration handoff

J. / Alex — looping in Finance (Mina) and Billing (Ben) to confirm the specifics. Ben — can you comment on how AWS Marketplace invoicing shows PO numbers and tax? Mina — I'll need you to review the amendment draft (attached) for accounting impact and confirm our ability to issue the one-time migration credit.

Ben: AWS issues invoices to the buyer (BlueArc) and includes tax breakdown based on buyer tax profile. However, when we list in the marketplace we can choose whether Redwood collects payment through AWS or via a reseller arrangement — for BlueArc we recommend standard AWS direct billing so their AP team receives one vendor invoice. Ben, please confirm fields we need to populate to align with BlueArc's PO template.

Mina: The attached Renewal_Amendment_Draft.pdf includes the credit line and proposed effective date of 2027-09-01. If you need adjusted language for revenue recognition, flag it here.

Thanks,
Marissa
Head of Sales Operations | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com

Attachment: Renewal_Amendment_Draft.pdf

From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>
To: J. Sullivan <j.sullivan@procure.bluearc.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Logan Wright <logan.wright@redwoodinference.com>, Mina Haddad <mina.haddad@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Tue, 29 Jun 2027 08:15:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Invoice routing playbook + renewal migration handoff

J. / Alex — quick technical answers from Billing: 
- AWS Marketplace invoices include SKU, description, quantity, unit price and tax when applicable. We can push the BlueArc PO number onto the invoice if you provide the exact PO value to include.
- For the runout direct invoice (if any usage falls in the overlap period), Redwood will issue a final invoice referencing your PO and we will mark the renewal start date as Sept 1 for Marketplace billing.
- Attachments: I included a short SKU mapping export for our finance system (Marketplace_SKU_Mapping.xlsx) and a sample invoice PDF that shows field placement.

One ask: Contracts will need the DocuSign envelope to reference the exact PO. If you confirm PO 45892 is the live PO we should reference, we'll bake that into the amendment before sending.

— Ben Carter
Sr. Revenue Ops Manager | Redwood Inference
ben.carter@redwoodinference.com

Attachment: Sample_Marketplace_Invoice_Sample.pdf

From: Alex Kim <alex.kim@bluearc.com>
To: Logan Wright <logan.wright@redwoodinference.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: J. Sullivan <j.sullivan@procure.bluearc.com>, Contracts <contracts@bluearc.com>
Date: Wed, 30 Jun 2027 10:02:00 -0400
Subject: Re: Invoice routing playbook + renewal migration handoff

Thanks everyone — we can confirm PO 45892 is the one to reference. I've attached the signed placeholder PO (BlueArc_PO_45892.pdf) and our AP contact: ap-team@bluearc.com. Please send the DocuSign amendment and let us know if we should expect any interim direct invoice.

If Marketplace billing starts on Sept 1, we request that any runout invoice be delivered by Aug 15 to allow processing before month-end close.

Best,
Alex
Head of Finance Operations | BlueArc Systems

Attachment: BlueArc_PO_45892.pdf

From: Logan Wright <logan.wright@redwoodinference.com>
To: Alex Kim <alex.kim@bluearc.com>, J. Sullivan <j.sullivan@procure.bluearc.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>, Mina Haddad <mina.haddad@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Wed, 30 Jun 2027 11:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Invoice routing playbook + renewal migration handoff

Perfect — thanks for confirming PO 45892 and the AP contact. Action items we will execute today: 
- I will send the DocuSign envelope (Renewal_Amendment_Draft.pdf) and include PO 45892 in the amendment body. Expect the envelope link via DocuSign within the hour.
- Ben will queue the final runout invoice for delivery by Aug 12 to meet your Aug 15 processing target.
- Mina will confirm revenue recognition language and finalize the 3% migration credit.
- Marissa and I will coordinate a short technical entitlement cutover window (Sept 1, 02:00–04:00 PT) and share the change freeze notice two weeks before.

If anything changes on your side, flag it here; otherwise I'll follow up with the DocuSign link shortly.

Thanks — talk soon.

— Logan Wright
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
logan.wright@redwoodinference.com
+1 (415) 555-0123

Related link: https://www.docusign.com/en/link/abcdef123456
